cases: All 20 previously exposed repositories, one fresh attempt per arm. Compare against stock GPT-6.1 Sol Medium with identical tasks, resources, deadlines and existing graders. Review both proposals and the actual merge in three blind rotations.
hypothesis: A direct workflow for locally verifiable changes will reduce effort. Checking a previously accepted input when extending a condition will preserve more public behavior. Develop runs standalone. Both arms may plan or delegate.

metrics.quality: Unweighted mean functional full-PR score over all 20. A missing PR, failed mandatory gate or confirmed critical defect scores zero.
metrics.time: Mean checkout-to-submission or timeout over all 20 per arm. Report completed-pair times separately.
metrics.cost: Total proposal cost across all attempts, including descendant usage under frozen rates. Report incomplete meters and known bounds, with judge and qualification costs separate.

stop_rule: At least two of quality >= 1.10 times stock, time <= 0.90 times stock, or cost <= 0.90 times stock. Count a metric only when measured or established by conservative bounds. Report all three outcomes. This historical comparison does not measure generalization.
selection: One full run on the exposed historical roster. A separate Commander pilot compares this identical Develop package with and without Superpowers. Keep its results separate.
